scope: Desk research of public vendor documentation; no paid accounts, comparative processing tests or customer interviews performed

entries.name: DaData
entries.confirmed: File plus JSON schema returns structured fields and per-field confidence; PDF/JPG/PNG up to 20 MB; documented default 10 requests/minute/IP.
entries.implication: Generic extraction is a benchmark candidate, NOT an equivalent substitute. Its price cannot price our decision/condition/amount handling without a common-contract evaluation.
entries.unknown: Comparative accuracy on our court corpus; enterprise volume terms; suitability for each client's data policy

entries.name: Smart Engines
entries.confirmed: Autonomous SDK for structured documents, standard forms and primary accounting documents; documentation lists 70 document types and multiple operating systems.
entries.price_observed: Not established from the reviewed documentation
entries.implication: A strong alternative when local processing is essential. Our external-model pipeline cannot currently claim an equivalent closed contour.
entries.unknown: Support and accuracy for the exact bankruptcy documents; commercial quotation

entries.name: ContentCapture / Content AI
entries.confirmed: Annual-volume licensing through partners; subscriptions for one or three years; some modules are licensed separately.
entries.price_observed: Published recommended minimum 450000 RUB/year; actual partner price and configuration vary
entries.implication: Potential opening for a narrower implementation, but our lower total cost has not yet been measured.
entries.unknown: Comparable project implementation cost, required modules and exact workflow functionality

entries.name: ПАУ
entries.confirmed: Existing case, creditor, task, correspondence and report workflow; templates and some imports. Already embedded in the target segment.
entries.price_observed: Published editions from 42880 RUB; this is not a per-page OCR tariff
entries.implication: Study first-hand complaints and current remaining corrections even though the vendor advertises automation. Do not presume reliability, satisfied users or that the whole product is replaceable by our OCR.
entries.unknown: Supported write integration for our fields; actual customer residual manual work

entries.name: ПАУ support documentation
entries.category: Workflow gap to validate with users
entries.confirmed: Report instructions distinguish automatically populated sections from data that users still enter manually.
entries.implication: Useful interview question and process map, not proof of a complaint, purchasing intent or a missing feature in every customer version.
entries.unknown: How often this occurs, its time cost, and whether document extraction solves it

entries.name: ПравоДела (ex. Casebook)
entries.confirmed: Case monitoring, company checks, bankruptcy information and creditor registers; higher tier adds access to case materials and court filing.
entries.price_observed: Published annual Standard 78000 RUB and Pro 108000 RUB
entries.implication: First ask whether required data is already available via the incumbent. Extracting it again may add no value.
entries.unknown: Client-specific API/export terms and remaining integration gaps

entries.name: Bankro.TECH
entries.confirmed: User manual describes document handling and a work queue for judicial acts not automatically recognized. The manual is historical.
entries.implication: Automated court-act processing is not a new category. Explore unresolved exceptions and integration, not unsupported uniqueness claims.
entries.unknown: Current product version, exact extraction accuracy, customer satisfaction and present commercial terms

entries.name: ArbitrKIT
entries.confirmed: Advertises bankruptcy CRM with document generation, payments and analytics.
entries.price_observed: Not established for a comparable extraction integration
entries.implication: Partner hypothesis only. A product website proves sector fit, not that the company wants our OCR.
entries.unknown: Customer requests for extraction, API capability, existing suppliers and willingness to partner

entries.name: ABBYY
entries.confirmed: Vendor describes extraction and validation for legal workflows and publishes customer examples.
entries.implication: Benchmark workflow and review capabilities. Vendor success stories are not independent demand evidence for Russian prospects.
entries.unknown: Relevant availability/terms, like-for-like performance and customer-side review evidence

entries.name: Rafinad.AI
entries.confirmed: Official instructions describe court-act upload and automatic procedure-field population. These are vendor claims, not independently tested accuracy.
entries.implication: Include as a direct comparison candidate, with user reviews and task-level tests. Do not confuse it with rafinad.io.
entries.unknown: Current accuracy, customer correction time, integration fit and total cost

unverified_claims: Every remaining manual field is an OCR problem
A vacancy for an OCR developer indicates willingness to buy a service
next_evidence: Independent customer accounts with exact workflow context
Five buyer interviews about the last actual document-handling incident
A blinded common-corpus comparison against at least one available alternative
A paid pilot or an explicit refusal with reason
evidence_standard: Vendor statements are documented capabilities, not verified effectiveness. User testimony, reproduced failures and comparative benchmarks are separate evidence classes.
